description: A Jan 15 Reddit post says a demonstration occurred on Avenue de la Liberté and describes two opposing sidewalk groups, one with a Luxembourgish flag and one with papers/dark clothing. It identifies no demand/cause or crowd count, so neither ≥50 simultaneous attendance nor a demand to Luxembourg state/policy is established.
required_followup: Look for contemporaneous local reporting or other independent public documentation identifying the gathering, its demand and attendance; absent that, retain as unresolved lead rather than coding an event.
